findings.claim: Two of kmctl's user-facing strings still send the user to "the README's install section": the `kmctl plugin patch --help` epilog (packages/kmctl/src/kmctl/__init__.py:1063) and the refusal when apm.lock.yaml lists no kmctl package (packages/kmctl/src/kmctl/plugin.py:800). The README a user finds first, the root one on GitHub, no longer has an install section. They should name kmctl's README (packages/kmctl/README.md), as the change already does in docs/reference/commands.md and as init's output does ("the kmctl README's install section").
